## ODF-001 — Accepted checks repeated
**Meaning:** Shared guidance requires repeating an accepted unchanged suite at
slice boundaries, wasting execution time.
**Response:** [Reuse accepted checks](../../../.planning/seeds/SEED-001-existing.md#reuse-checks), queued, not resolved.

**Source mappings:** open-dough/DD-102 → ODF-001; alpha/DD-102 → ODF-001.
Concrete match: G1 explicitly requires rerunning accepted unchanged suites.
### Occurrences
- open-dough / open-dough-checks; 2026-10-17T10:00:00+09:00; Codex; untagged G1.
  Three redundant runs cost 39 minutes. [Capture](../../../evidence/checks.txt),
  [reported G1](../../../.open-dough/reported-guidance.md), [source](../../../DearDough.md#odf-001--accepted-suite-repeated).
- alpha / alpha-checks; 2026-10-17T10:00:00+09:00; Codex; untagged G1.
  Three redundant runs cost 39 minutes. Source: alpha:DearDough.md DD-102 (adopted ODF-001);
  evidence: alpha:evidence/checks.txt and alpha:.open-dough/reported-guidance.md G1.
**Assessment:** Two distinct project/execution identities; 78 minutes observed waste.
Releases are untagged fixture G1, not today's installed version. The fixture has
no tagged correction or verified adoption/exposure receipts; current proof-reuse
language does not establish what these executions adopted or complete the queued
outcome. Retain the existing response and require actual response/release evidence
there; do not infer post-fix recurrence or allocate another implementation story.

release, historical correction transition or relevant adoption/outcome receipt is

implementation gap assessed separately, rather than another isolation implementation.
